messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem — we need concrete owners for regression tests, prompt evals, nightly load, and chaos drills. Short sync.
kevin: I can own the targeted regression suite for KV behaviors (warm vs cold, eviction edge cases). ETA: 2 weeks for initial PR.
sanjay: I'll take chaos drills (network latency + eviction race + CPU spikes). Plan: runbook draft 1 week, automation 3 weeks. Need staging window from @lucy.
eva: I'll extract the prompt seeds that regressed and add them to evals as YAML. Need the golden outputs and a tiny extraction script. ETA: 10 days.
apsara: I can add a capped nightly load job against a small dedicated slice labeled `nightly/incident-smoke`. Will limit to 75 concurrent clients. CI job in 48h.
devops: We'll provision a `svc-chaos-runner` with scoped RBAC and a staging-only vault token. Can do in 48h once owners confirm.
lucy: +1 to staged drills. Send schedule and exact endpoints for approval.
kevin: I'll also draft a regression PR checklist (data source, repro, thresholds, CI tag `regression-cache`). PR tomorrow.
maya: Owners summary: regression -> @kevin (14d), chaos drills -> @sanjay (21d automation), prompt evals -> @eva (10d), nightly load -> @apsara (48h), RBAC -> @devops (48h). Tag PRs with `incident-1843001234`.
sanjay: I'll propose a recurring ticket to monitor this cache-thrash pattern monthly so we can spot regressions over time.
eva: Proposed eval thresholds: semantic sim >= .86, token overlap >= .68, fail-on-delta >6% vs baseline. We can tune after first run.
maya: Add alert: if nightly job shows >10% tail latency increase or eval fails, auto-open P0 and tag oncall.
lucy: Scheduling OK for staging. Ping me with preferred windows.
maya: Thanks — reconvene next Wed 9am PT to review PRs and infra.
